feedback: Investigation was clean. The latency_origin tool immediately pointed to `ad` with high self-time, which combined with zero errors and zero CPU saturation made this clearly a latency-only incident. The JVM GC change on ad was the only change on the implicated service and its diff_touches (jvm_gc, heap_settings) perfectly match intermittent stall pauses. The investigate_parallel findings were useful but the frontend investigator over-attributed 1 error span as a service fault when it was really a downstream timeout from ad stalling. The tools worked well for this latency scenario.
